key_insight: The Haar-distributed ensemble of pure states maximizes basis-free relative entropy ensemble coherence in every finite dimension, linking coherence to quantum communication limits.
engineering_relevance: Ensemble coherence provides theoretical upper bounds for postselection-based information gains and asymptotic secret key rates in qubit B92 quantum key distribution.
method: Prove that the normalized Haar ensemble attains the tight coherence upper bound.
Bound the informational advantage of postselective measurements over the Holevo quantity for two equiprobable pure states.
Bound the asymptotic B92 secret key rate using Alice’s ensemble coherence.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports analytical proofs and protocol-specific bounds, not numerical benchmarks or hardware experiments.
watch_item: The operational bounds address restricted settings and do not establish achievable performance under finite-key or noisy-device conditions.
paper_title: Ensemble basis-free coherence for quantum communication
